Hi team —

Attached is the v3 playbook for the Q1 Launchpad (Q1_Launchpad_Playbook_v3.pdf) plus the OKR review sheet Ive been consolidating (OKR_review_sheet.xlsx). This thread is the single source for approvals and cross-org clearance before we publish the owner playbook to the org and kick off dry-runs.

As a reminder, the scope here is the quarter kickoff bundle: OKR owners, success metrics, signal dashboards, and the QBR dry-run agenda. High level asks:

- Marissa: please confirm owners and the rollcall template. We need owner confirmations and a scheduled dry-run slot by EOD Thu (4/20).
- Ben: slides 3	6 have the proposed measurement rubrics. Id like your sign-off or a short edit pass by EOD Wed (4/16).
- Kimberly/Vivek: compliance check on metric telemetry and retention policy. If there are blockers for QBR data pulls, flag them here.

Ive also linked the working folder and the support ticket (SUP-4821) where engineering tracked the batching changes that affect the latency metric. Please review the playbook comments inline.

Goal: consolidated sign-off from the five owners below so we can publish the playbook to the wider leadership channel by Fri 4/21.

Thanks — quick replies welcome (a one-line ack is fine).

Best,
Olga
